delta_definition: AnchorBoost minus log-linear; negative favors AnchorBoost
sign_flip_diagnostic: Exact two-sided paired sign flip, descriptive; Yuan primary endpoints each p=0.125

compound_labels.ewart: Garside rank 1-3 hepatotoxic versus 4-5 non-hepatotoxic; source Table 4
compound_labels.yuan: Author-described mechanism groups, paragraphs 16-18; ALP is allopurinol
compound_labels.purpose: Post hoc error description; source mechanism labels neither entered fitting nor explain error causally

interpretation.independence: Endpoint, configuration, design and replicate counts add zero independent chemicals
interpretation.units: Endpoint errors retain their published units. Cross-endpoint descriptive comparison uses per-chemical MAE/observed curve span; zero spans yield null.
interpretation.singleton_classes: A one-chemical group has a degenerate bootstrap interval and supplies no between-chemical uncertainty estimate
physical_conditions: Yuan has 4 positive doses per chemical, producing only 16 LDH or 12 ALT training rows per fold; frozen min_samples_leaf=50 yields unsplittable trees and a constant residual correction to interpolation
Ewart missing readings retain masks; entirely missing dose levels are absent from that endpoint's curve
Yuan vehicle dose 0 is outside log-dose prediction and ALP has no ALT curve
Ewart uses primary human liver chips; Yuan uses human cell lines and its ALT experiment uses a PBMC variant
Source chip/replicate mappings do not establish prospective physical chip savings

facts_for_methods: The frozen AnchorBoost recipe and log-concentration linear interpolation were compared using leave-one-chemical-out predictions. Training used every three-concentration context. Ewart used five fixed test contexts per chemical and endpoint; Yuan used all three lowest-dose-anchored contexts available from four positive concentrations. Design MAEs were averaged within chemical, then equally across chemicals. Original paired percentile intervals resampled chemicals 4,000 times with seed 0; a separately labelled 10,000-resample analysis uses the same seed and chemical unit. Both published units and lowest-dose centering are reported, together with all Yuan cell-depletion configurations.
facts_for_results: Ewart2022 ALBUMIN included 6 chemicals: AnchorBoost MAE 24.796, interpolation MAE 24.0722, difference +0.723804 (original 95% CI -8.0212 to +9.8021), with 4/2/0 wins/losses/ties. Ewart2022 ALT included 6 chemicals: AnchorBoost MAE 1.46352, interpolation MAE 1.49191, difference -0.0283888 (original 95% CI -0.1220 to +0.0674), with 3/3/0 wins/losses/ties. Ewart2022 Morphology included 6 chemicals: AnchorBoost MAE 0.364336, interpolation MAE 0.386805, difference -0.0224696 (original 95% CI -0.0802 to +0.0288), with 3/3/0 wins/losses/ties. Yuan2025 ALT included 4 chemicals: AnchorBoost MAE 0.0313994, interpolation MAE 0.0293175, difference +0.00208194 (original 95% CI +0.0011 to +0.0030), with 0/4/0 wins/losses/ties. Yuan2025 LDH included 5 chemicals: AnchorBoost MAE 9.1168, interpolation MAE 8.3768, difference +0.740001 (original 95% CI +0.2149 to +1.0086), with 1/4/0 wins/losses/ties.
risk_facts_for_methods: Compound-level forecasting risk is described using the existing held-out predictions. MAE, signed error, maximum error, and interpolation/extrapolation errors retain their endpoint units. A separate descriptive scale divides MAE by the span of the chemical's observed positive-dose means. Source-defined hepatotoxicity or mechanism labels provide post hoc subgroups. Chemical bootstrap resampling uses 10,000 draws and seed 0. Singleton subgroup intervals have one chemical as their entire support. All configurations and outcomes are included; these descriptive labels enter no model fitting or parameter selection.
risk_facts_for_results: The largest primary Ewart2022 ALBUMIN AnchorBoost MAE was 38.0476 for Troglitazone. The largest primary Ewart2022 ALT AnchorBoost MAE was 6.51795 for Trovafloxacin. The largest primary Ewart2022 Morphology AnchorBoost MAE was 0.634792 for Clozapine. The largest primary Yuan2025 ALT AnchorBoost MAE was 0.0488142 for Acetaminophen. The largest primary Yuan2025 LDH AnchorBoost MAE was 14.803 for Acetaminophen.
source_material: Ewart source data and scripts are in ../ooc. Yuan publisher material remains at its original public DOI; this file provides computed error statistics, not a redistributed source table or figure.
